description: This file defines the RequestException class within the GuzzleHttp\Exception namespace. It models exceptions related to HTTP requests, including methods to wrap exceptions, create detailed exception messages based on HTTP response status codes, and access request/response details.

classes.name: RequestException
classes.description: Represents HTTP request-related exceptions, capable of wrapping other throwables, generating detailed error messages based on response status, and providing access to the associated request, response, and handler context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new RequestException with a message, request, optional response, previous exception, and handler context.

methods.name: wrapException
methods.description: Wraps a generic throwable into a RequestException, attaching the related request.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new exception with a normalized message based on the request and response, including specific messages for client and server errors.

methods.name: obfuscateUri
methods.description: Obfuscates URI user info by masking passwords if present.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the request that caused the exception.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the response associated with the exception, if available.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Checks whether a response was received for the request.

methods.name: getHandlerContext
methods.description: Retrieves additional contextual information from the underlying handler.
